name: Westchester County, New York (United States)
description: Divided horizontally orange over blue, with a large white triangle whose base takes up the whole hoist, bearing the county emblem in blue within a ring of stars.
history: Westchester County is a suburban county north of New York City. The flag was adopted on 1 May 1939 by the county's Committee on Budget and Appropriations after a citizens' committee appointed on 27 March 1939 selected the design; the orange, white and blue recall the Dutch tricolour. It was replaced in 1985 by a version bearing the county's name.
